name: Tatton Jacob
title: Projectionist · Trainer · Media Server Op
bio: Tatton spent an integral 6.5 years working directly for Disguise in the United States as a critical problem solver and lead training resource, working between show programmers, clients, and developers to gain familiarity across a wide variety and scale of shows — before eventually breaking into freelance to more tangibly affect shows during their full range of creation. Tack on an affinity for travel and 7+ years of touring before all of this and you'll find an extremely well-versed, level-headed under pressure and enjoyable (because why not) team member.

projects.title: The Dwarf Grill — Chick-fil-A NEXT (2026)
projects.desc: 4D immersive experience incorporating projection, LED, scent, sound, lights, and web interaction for Brand Apart via Disguise. Full sensory environment design and integration.

projects.title: The Tragedy of Coriolanus — Brooklyn (2026)
projects.desc: Video playback, camera preset control, and live Touch Designer integration for Theater for a New Audience in Brooklyn with POSSIBLE via Disguise.

projects.title: Domino Sugar Factory Projection — Brooklyn (2025)
projects.desc: 25+ 4K projector blend on the iconic Domino Sugar Factory for outdoor large-scale projection with ATD Visual via Disguise. Executed twice.

projects.title: Top of the Rock Omnical — Rockefeller Center (2024)
projects.desc: Permanent installation at Top of the Rock with Electrosonic and THG via Disguise and Omnical — one of New York's most visited observation experiences.
